Package index

Simulation

Generate synthetic tissues with a planted cell-cell interaction, and convert them to Seurat objects.

generate_sim()
Simulate Spatial Coordinates and Cell Types
generate_sim_groups()
Generate multi-sample simulated data with disease-group structure
sim_to_seurat()
Convert simulated cells to a Seurat object with one FOV per sample

Single-sample analysis

Spatial neighborhood analysis (SNA), spatial co-localization score (sCLS), radius-based co-occurrence and interaction spots for one tissue.

nhood_enrichment()
Neighborhood Enrichment (Generic method)
plot_nhood_heatmap()
Heatmap of a single-sample neighbourhood enrichment with significance
nhood_enrichment.Seurat()
Neighborhood Enrichment (Seurat Method)
cooccur_local()
Local Co-occurrence Score (Generic method)
cooccur_local.Seurat()
Local Co-occurrence Score (Seurat Method)
cooccur_local_oe()
Local co-localization score with a permutation-calibrated expectation
calc_co_occurrence_for_radius()
Calculate Co-occurrence Matrix for a Given Radius
compute_co_occurrence_ratio()
Compute Enrichment Ratios from Count Matrix
search_interaction_spot()
Search for Spatial Interaction Spots

Multi-sample scores

Compute a score per image (or patient) and return a tidy table ready for group comparison.

build_sample_design()
Build a sample design table for disease-group comparisons
nhood_enrichment_per_sample()
Per-sample neighborhood enrichment
cooccur_ratio_per_sample()
Per-sample radius-based co-occurrence ratio
cooccur_local_per_sample()
Per-sample local co-occurrence summary
interaction_spot_per_sample()
Per-sample interaction-spot summary
summarize_by_patient()
Aggregate per-image scores to one row per patient

Segmentation-free analysis (experimental)

Work directly on transcript coordinates: bin transcripts, estimate the cross pair correlation of gene sets model-free, or fit a random-feature log-Gaussian Cox process factor model (after Gundersen et al. 2021).

read_xenium_transcripts()
Read a Xenium transcript table
bin_transcripts()
Bin transcript coordinates on a square grid
pcf_cross()
Empirical cross pair correlation of two gene sets (segmentation-free)
pcf_matrix()
Cross pair correlation for every pair of gene sets
colocalization_gene_matrix()
Gene-by-gene co-localization of transcripts
colocalization_modules()
Cluster genes into co-localization modules
colocalization_submodules()
Split a co-localization module into sub-modules
module_enrichment()
Interpret co-localization modules with gene sets
module_enrichr()
Query enrichR for each co-localization module
rff_programs()
Find spatial gene programs (recommended entry point)
fit_spatial_rff()
Fit a random-feature spatial factor model to binned transcripts
rff_fields()
Latent fields of a fitted random-feature LGCP at cells, transcripts or any point
rff_offset()
Offset for a residual random-feature model: expression explained by known structure
rff_factor_test()
Significance of residual spatial factors by parametric bootstrap
rff_program_test()
Gene-program test on smoothed residuals, with the fitted RFLVM as null model
fit_spatial_rff_joint()
Random-feature factor model across several windows with shared loadings
rff_program_test_joint()
Gene-program test across several tissues or windows with shared loadings
rff_control_reference()
Negative-control reference for calibrated program tests
rff_transfer_test()
Calibrated test for a gene program transferred to new data
rff_lengthscale_profile()
Length scale of each spatial program by held-out likelihood
rff_reach()
Reach (decay length) implied by a profiled length scale
rff_lengthscale_vi()
Length scale of each program by the variational evidence (ELBO)
rff_lengthscale_mcmc()
Posterior of a program's length scale by MCMC (reference)
rff_expected_offset()
Offset from the cell types that own each bin's transcripts
rff_report()
Interactive HTML report of a residual RFLVM analysis
rff_pair_correlation()
Model-based cross pair correlation from a fitted random-feature LGCP
colocalization_per_sample()
Per-sample segmentation-free co-localization of gene sets
simulate_transcripts()
Simulate transcript coordinates from a multivariate log-Gaussian Cox process
simulate_transcripts_groups()
Simulate a multi-sample case-control transcript dataset
lgcp_true_pair_correlation()
True cross pair correlation of a simulated LGCP

Group comparison

Test every cell-type pair between two groups.

compare_groups()
Compare disease groups across samples
associate_continuous()
Associate co-localization with a continuous clinical variable

Visualization

plot_group_delta_heatmap()
Heatmap of the disease-group effect for every cluster pair
plot_pair_boxplot()
Per-sample boxplot of one (or several) cluster pair(s) across groups
plot_volcano_groups()
Volcano plot of a compare_groups result
manual_colors
Default Manual Colors for Clusters

compute_count()

permute_clusters()
Permute Cluster Assignments and Recompute Counts
